description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository interactions, including setup of repositories, pushing, pulling, and handling alternates. It defines a series of test cases to verify Git behavior in scenarios involving forks and alternate object stores.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.
